newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Energy expects slowdown to persist.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Energy expects slowdown to persist.

text.p: Advanced Energy Industries Inc said Wednesday it anticipates a slowdown in demand for its products will persist for the next several quarters, hurting its results.

In announcing its third quarter results, the company said its lower earnings -- to $0.01 per share versus $0.21 per share in the same period the prior year -- was primarily the result of a decrease in shipments during the period as well as some unfavorable product mix.

"At the lower sales level unabsorbed manufacturing overhead resulted in significantly lower gross margins," Chief Executive Douglas Schatz said in a statement, adding that margins will not improve significantly until orders rebound.
The company said it has cut its staff to 628 employees from a high of 734. It said it intends to continue to reduce costs across the board until orders recovery.
Advanced Energy Industries manufactures power conversion devices for systems used to make semiconductors, data storage media and other products using thin-film technology.
